S10: Work exists before worker; a durable JOB with exact scope and verification is prepared before launch.
S11/S12: A worker has one prepared mission/return and lifecycle state is durable evidence; STARTED precedes material execution and DONE requires durable return/evidence.
S13/S14: No run means not started, and workers write independent run/status/return objects rather than a shared mutable status bottleneck.
S17/S18: The human is not a result courier; the parent/steward reads durable returns and alone integrates/accepts/promotes as authorized.
S24: No full parallel scale before one observed zero-memory canary completes prepared JOB -> launch -> STARTED -> RETURN -> DONE -> parent observation/integration.
S29: Inbox/events are optional targeted transport; normal orchestration remains Chat Object -> JOB -> Run -> RETURN -> parent integration.
